statements.status_notes: The vulnerable SRP plugin source is absent from the shipped cyrus-sasl2 artifacts. Debian builds cyrus-sasl2 with SRP disabled (--disable-srp, --disable-srp-setpass), and the built libsasl2-2, libsasl2-modules and libsasl2-modules-gssapi-mit packages contain no SRP module and no SRP strings. The SRP plugin was removed upstream in commit fb3724f43dc50247ff2bf02135457d6d77031654 (https://github.com/cyrusimap/cyrus-sasl/commit/fb3724f43dc50247ff2bf02135457d6d77031654). See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-129483
